method: Exact Mac archive extraction and executable; separate real-time native OS processes using shipped rpg_qa InputEvents. Fresh opening, copied save resume, and a controlled corrupt-primary/valid-backup recovery fixture. No MovieMaker or editor gameplay.
limitations: Generated inputs do not establish physical control comfort, human enjoyment or audio audition.
QA mode bypasses the ordinary single-instance lock; this runner does not test that lock.
Resume and corrupt-primary recovery use explicitly copied isolated saves, not ordinary player data.
Short process checks are not sustained performance measurements.
